releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.13.1 — Arabic fixes and the official icon.

• Fixed the seek bar and volume slider moving opposite to your finger in Arabic — media sliders now drag naturally, exactly like in English, and mini-player progress matches.
• Back arrows point the right way in Arabic.
• The official Team Nokiatis liquid-glass icon is now the app icon.
• New installs start on the Classic look with Round corners.
• Glass backgrounds now blend with your chosen theme color.
